default_compression_level.description: Default compression level (0-9, where 0 is fastest, 9 is best compression). Corresponds to pdlzip -0 through -9.

dictionary_size.description: Default dictionary size in bytes (12-27 for powers of 2, or explicit byte value). Corresponds to pdlzip -s, --dictionary-size. Default 8 MiB = 8388608 bytes.

match_length.description: Default match length limit in bytes. Corresponds to pdlzip -m, --match-length. Default 36 bytes.

keep_input_files.description: Keep input files after compression/decompression. Corresponds to pdlzip -k, --keep.

verbose_level.description: Verbosity level (0-2, where 0 is quiet, 1 is normal, 2 is very verbose). Corresponds to pdlzip -v, --verbose.

quiet_mode.description: Suppress all output messages. Corresponds to pdlzip -q, --quiet.

trailing_error.description: Exit with error status if trailing data is present. Corresponds to pdlzip -a, --trailing-error.

loose_trailing.description: Allow trailing data seeming corrupt header. Corresponds to pdlzip --loose-trailing.

output_directory.description: Default output directory for compressed files. Corresponds to pdlzip -o, --output.

files_to_compress.description: List of files to compress. Corresponds to pdlzip [files]. Each item is a file path.
